Game Overview

At its heart, Snowboard Frenzy is a skateboard game about race down dazzling snowfields as a fearless Yeti in Snowboard Frenzy. Execute gravity-defying tricks and smash penguins for extra points. Navigate icy terrains at breakneck speeds to beat the clock. Sharpen your skills and discover hidden shortcuts to claim the title of mountain champion in this thrilling winter adventure!
